name: Light Ray Extinction Optimization
definition: Optimization of direct illumination by estimating extinction values between a scatter vertex y and a point on the light source using the same data structure as camera ray visibility, but with stratified samples inserted into the structure.
summary: Light Ray Extinction Optimization accelerates direct illumination in Monte Carlo volume rendering by optimizing extinction estimates along light rays, distinctively rebuilding its data structure for each stochastic scattering location rather than updating progressively.
